about: [O6b critic] the door lying (&ten=parts): what it is (its box, its lean), a look at it from 2 m, then walk across it east-west and north-south: does it stop me?

steps.eval: (() => { const d = G.stage.smash.out.find(i=>i.part && i.kind==='cardoor'); const b=d.body; return JSON.stringify({p:[b.p.x,b.p.y,b.p.z].map(v=>+v.toFixed(2)), e:[b.e.x,b.e.y,b.e.z].map(v=>+v.toFixed(2)), q:[d.Q.x,d.Q.y,d.Q.z,d.Q.w].map(v=>+v.toFixed(2)), lie:!!d.lie, lieBox: d.lie ? {hx:d.lie.hx, hz:d.lie.hz, cx:d.lie.cx, cz:d.lie.cz, tag:d.lie.tag, y1:d.lie.y1, top:d.lie.top} : null, pitch:+N.controller.pitch.toFixed(2)}); })()

steps.walk: (() => { const d = G.stage.smash.out.find(i=>i.part && i.kind==='cardoor'); return [[d.body.p.x, d.body.p.z + 4.5], [d.body.p.x, d.body.p.z + 2.6]]; })()

steps.name: north across it
steps.walk: (() => { const d = G.stage.smash.out.find(i=>i.part && i.kind==='cardoor'); return [[d.body.p.x, d.body.p.z - 2.5]]; })()

steps.eval: (() => { const d = G.stage.smash.out.find(i=>i.part && i.kind==='cardoor'); return JSON.stringify({me:[N.controller.pos.x,N.controller.pos.y,N.controller.pos.z].map(v=>+v.toFixed(2)), door:[d.body.p.x,d.body.p.y,d.body.p.z].map(v=>+v.toFixed(2)), st:d.state}); })()

steps.name: east-west across it
steps.walk: (() => { const d = G.stage.smash.out.find(i=>i.part && i.kind==='cardoor'); return [[d.body.p.x + 2.5, d.body.p.z + 0.1], [d.body.p.x - 2.5, d.body.p.z + 0.1]]; })()

steps.eval: (() => { const d = G.stage.smash.out.find(i=>i.part && i.kind==='cardoor'); return JSON.stringify({me:[N.controller.pos.x,N.controller.pos.y,N.controller.pos.z].map(v=>+v.toFixed(2)), door:[d.body.p.x,d.body.p.y,d.body.p.z].map(v=>+v.toFixed(2)), st:d.state}); })()

steps.name: the bonnet: walk across it
steps.walk: (() => { const d = G.stage.smash.out.find(i=>i.part && i.kind==='carbonnet'); return [[d.body.p.x, d.body.p.z + 3], [d.body.p.x, d.body.p.z - 3]]; })()

steps.eval: (() => { const d = G.stage.smash.out.find(i=>i.part && i.kind==='carbonnet'); const b=d.body; return JSON.stringify({me:[N.controller.pos.x,N.controller.pos.y,N.controller.pos.z].map(v=>+v.toFixed(2)), p:[b.p.x,b.p.y,b.p.z].map(v=>+v.toFixed(2)), e:[b.e.x,b.e.y,b.e.z].map(v=>+v.toFixed(2)), st:d.state}); })()
